rbuilder.historical_builder_output_reason: The standard historical command does not calculate a real state root or produce the complete signed V6 validation request.

transaction_archive.reason_not_downloaded: Archive access was established, but mainnet has no Amsterdam activation in the checked chain spec, so this data cannot exercise parent BAL.

fork_compatibility.conclusion: Public mainnet history takes the intentional pre-Amsterdam fallback; Sepolia can have parent BALs but is not supplied by Mempool Dumpster.

blockers: No local Reth database contains post-Amsterdam state and parent BALs.
The public transaction archive is mainnet-only, while the checked mainnet chain spec has no Amsterdam activation.
The snapshot registry publishes no Sepolia snapshot; listed mainnet archive snapshots need about 1.7 TB and do not fit.
The standard historical builder uses MockRootHasher and the public test-relay has no V6 validation route.
